description: Just a few minutes from the Trocadéro, this elegant 110 sqm (1,184 sq ft) air-conditioned apartment offers the perfect setting for a Parisian stay with family, friends or colleagues. With 3 bedrooms, three en-suite showers and a whirlpool bath, plus a comfortable sofa bed, it can comfortably accommodate up to 8 guests.The spaceThis elegant 110 sqm, courtyard facing apartment is located on the second floor of a modern building with elevator access, in the heart of the prestigious Trocadéro district. Designed for families, friends or business travelers, it comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests thanks to its three bedrooms and convertible sofa bed.The apartment features a bright and spacious living area designed to comfortably spend time together while allowing everyone to enjoy their own privacy. The lounge includes a connected TV, air conditioning and a comfortable sofa bed.The open kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for a seamless stay: dishwasher, oven, induction hob, microwave, kettle, toaster and a Nespresso Magimix coffee machine. Complimentary coffee and tea are provided for your arrival. A central island and a convivial dining area complete the space.Each bedroom offers hotel-quality bedding, air conditioning, a smart TV and its own en-suite bathing facilities.The master suite, set apart from the other bedrooms for additional privacy, features a king-size bed and a spacious en-suite bathroom with a balneotherapy bathtub, hammam shower and toilet.The two additional bedrooms both feature queen-size beds and their own en-suite shower rooms. An additional separate toilet is also available in the apartment.For your comfort, towels, bed linen, shampoo, shower gel, laundry detergent, dishwasher tablets and other everyday essentials are provided.High-speed
